## Procedure

1. Maintain the start position and squeeze shoulder blades back and down while flexing elbows
2. Continue to pull the handle until it touches the upper abdomen (-33)
3. Return the bar to the start position in a slow, controlled manner

## Coaching Points

- Maintain a flat back throughout the entire exercise
- Concentrate on maintaining a constant body position and pulling shoulder blades together
- Avoid using momentum to complete the lift
- Focus on achieving a full range of motion

## 4c. Lat Pulldown

Exercise Objective: Develop strength in the muscles of the upper back
